COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ORDER
I, General the Honourable David Hurley AC DSC (Retd), Governor-General of the
Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke
all administrative arrangements previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department; and
(b) matters arising under the legislation administered by a Minister of State
administering the Department.
2. The legislation administered by a Minister of State administering a Department is:
(a) the legislation referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;
and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part of
the Schedule.
This Order will commence on | February 2020.
Signed and sealed with the
al of Australia on
5 December 2019
d Hurley
Governor-General
By His Excellency’s Command
cett Morrison
Prime Minister

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ORDER
I, QUENTIN BRYCE, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting
with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke all administrative arrangements
previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;
and
(b) matters arising under the legislation administered by a Minister of State
administering the Department.
2. The legislation administered by a Minister of State administering a Department is:
(a) the legislation referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that
Department; and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part
of the Schedule.

I, QUENTIN BRYCE, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting
with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke all administrative arrangements
previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;

(b) matters arising under the legislation administered by a Minister of State
administering the Department.
2. The legislation administered by a Minister of State administering a Department is:

Department; and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ORDER
I, QUENTIN BRYCE, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with
the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke all administrative arrangements
previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;
and
(b) matters arising under the legislation administered by a Minister of State
administering the Department.
2. The legislation administered by a Minister of State administering a Department is:
(a) the legislation referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that
Department; and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part
of the Schedule.

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ORDER
I, PHILIP MICHAEL JEFFERY, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of
Australia, acting with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke all
administrative arrangements previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;

administering the Department.

Department; and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part
of the Schedule.

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ORDER
J, PHILIP MICHAEL JEFFERY, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of
Australia, acting with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, revoke all
administrative arrangements previously ordered and order that:
1. The matters dealt with by a Department of State include:
(a) the matters referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that Department;
and
(b) matters arising under the legislation administered by a Minister of State
administering the Department.
2. The legislation administered by a Minister of State administering a Department is:
(a) _ the legislation referred to in the Part of the Schedule relating to that
Department; and
(b) legislation passed before or after the date of this Order, that relates to a matter
dealt with by the Department, not being legislation referred to in another Part
of the Schedule.

ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of
the Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrange-
ments in operation immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters
arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State or each of the Ministers of State, as the case may be,
administering that Department.
The enactments administered by a Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified
the third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column oppesite to the name of another Department.

COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINJIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of
the Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements to take effect on and from
24 July 1987 in substitution for the arrangements in operation immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by cach Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters
arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State or each of the Ministers of State, as the case may be,
administering that Department.
The enactments administered by a Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified in
the third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column opposite to the name of another Department.
GIVEN under my Hand and
{L.S.) the Great Seai of Australia
on 24 July 1987.
STEPHEN
Governor-General

[Extract taken from Commonwealth of Australia Special Gazette dated 3 February 1987]
COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice
the Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements to take effect on and from
February 1987 in substitution for the arrangements in operation immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by cach Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters
arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified in
the third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column opposite to the name of another Department.
GIVEN under my Hand and
(L.S.} the Great Seal of Australia
on 30 January 1987.
STEPHEN
Governor-General
By His Exceilency’s Command.
HAWKE
Prime Minister
(Ex. Min. No. 1)

ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of
the Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements to take effect on and from 1]
February 1986 in substitution for the arrangements in operation immediately before the date of this Order:

the third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column opposite to the name of another Department.

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, the Governor-General of the Commonweaith of Australia, acting with the advice of the
Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the folowing administrative arrangements to take effect on and from 2 July 1984 in
substitution for the arrangements in operation immediately before that date:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the Schedule to
this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters arising under the
enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified in the
third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether passed before
or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an enactment specified in that
column opposite to the name of another Department.

COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR NINIAN MARTIN STEPHEN, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of the
Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative acrangements in substitution for the arrangements in
operation immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the Schedule to
this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters arising under the en-
actments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified in the
third column of the Schedule 1o this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether passed before
or after the date of this Order) that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an enactment specified in that
column opposite to the name of another Department.
GIVEN under.my Hand and

column opposite tothe name of another Department.

column opposite to the name of another Department.

SPECIAL
COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR ZELMAN COWEN, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of the Federal
Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrangements in operation
immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the Schedule to

COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
Acts Interpretation Act 1901
ORDER UNDER SECTION 193 (2)
WHEREAS in the provisions of certain Acts and
Regulations there are references to the Department of
the Northern Territory:
AND WHEREAS that Department has been
abolished:
NOW THEREFORE J, Sir Zelman Cowen, the
Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia,
acting with the advice of the Federal Executive
Council, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of
section 198 of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901, by
this Order direct that any provision of any Act or
Regulations in which there is a reference to the
Department of the Northern Territory shall have
efiect as if there were substituted for any reference
in that provision to that Department a reference to
the Department of Home Affairs.
GIVEN under my Hand and the Great Seal
({L.S.) of Australia on 28 September 1978.
ZELMAN COWEN
Governor-General
By His Excellency’s Command,
P. DURACK

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
I, SIR ZELMAN COWEN, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of the
Federal Executive Counci]—
(a) hereby revoke so much of the Administrative Arrangements Order made on 20 December 1977 as relates to
the Department of National Development;
(b} hereby approve the following administrative arrangements:
(i) the matters dealt with by the Department of State specified in the first column of the Schedule to this
Order include the matters specified in the second column of that Schedule and other maiters arising
under the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department;
(ii} the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering the Department specified in the
first column of the Schedule to this Order are the enactments specified in the third column of the
Schedule to this Order and any other enactment, whether passed before or after the date of this Order,
that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department (not being an enactment specified in relation
to another Department in so much of the Administrative Arrangements Order made on 20
December 1977 as is continued in force by this Order or in this Order);
the enactments administered by the Minister of State for Trade and Resources no longer include the
Coal Research Assistance Act 1977 and the Liguid Fuel (Defence Stocks) Act 1949, and the matters
dealt with by the Department of Trade and Resources no longer include matters arising under those
C ) Acts;

(c) hereby approve the continuation in force, subject to paragraphs (a} and (b) of this Order, of the administrative
arrangements set out in the Administrative Arrangements Order made on 20 December 1977.

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS

SIR JOHN ROBERT KERR, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Austratia, acting with the advice
of the Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrange-
ments in operation immediately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule and other matters
arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified
in the third column of the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order} that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column opposite to the name of another Department.
(L.S.)

JOHN R. KERR

INSTRUMENT OF APPOINTMENT
SER JOHN ROBERT KERR, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice
of the Federal Executive Council, in pursuance of section 15 of the Australian Bureau of Statistics Act 1975, hereby—

ACTS INTERPRETATION ACT 1901
ORDER UNDER SECTION
WHEREAS in the provisions of the Acts and Regulations specified in the first column of the Schedule and in
provisions of other instruments made under those Acts and Regulations there are references to the Department of
the Treasury and to the office of the Secretary to the Department of the Treasury {being an office the holder of which
is, by virtue of section 25 of the Public Service Aet 1922, the Permanent Head of the Department of the Treasury}:
AND WHEREAS, by virtue of administrative arrangements ordered by the Governor-General on 7 December 1976,
there is a change in the matters dealt with by the Department of the Treasury but the name of that Department and
the name of that office are not changed:
NOW THEREFORE I, SIR JOHN ROBERT KERR, the Governor-General of the Commonwealth of Australia,
acting with the advice of the Federal Executive Council, in pursuance of sub-sections (2) and (3) of section 19Ba of
the Acrs Interpretation Act 1901, by this Order direct that each of those provisions shall have effect as if there were
substituted for the reference specified in the second column of the Schedule in relation to the provision the reference
specified in the third column of that Schedule opposite to the first-mentioned reference.
(L.S,) GIVEN under my Hand and the Great Seal of Australia on 7 December 1976.
JOHN R. KERR

{Ex. Min, No. 32)
AUSTRALIA
ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
SIR JOHN ROBERT KERR, the Governor-General of Australia, acting with the advice of the Executive Council,
hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrangemenis in operation immedi-
ately before the date of this Order:
The matters dealt with by each Department of State include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department ia the first column of that Schedule and other matters
arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified
in the third column of the Scheduie to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether
passed before or after the date of this Order} that relates to a matter dealt with by that Department, not being an
enactment specified in that column opposite to the name of another Department.

Given under my Hand and the Great Seal of Australia on 5 October 1976.
(L.5.)
JOHN R. KERR
Governor-General
By His Excellency’s Command,
MALCOLM FRASER

ABOLITION AND ESTABLISHMENT OF DEPARTMENTS AND RELATED MATTERS
HIS Excellency the Governor-General has been pleased:
to approve of the abolition, in pursuance of section 64 of the Constitution, of the following Departments of
State, namely—
(a) The Department of the Northern Territory
(b) The Department of Northern Development
(2) to approve of the abolition, in pursuance of the Public Service Act 1922-1975, of the following offices of
Permanent Head, namely— ;
(a) The Office of The Secretary to thé Department of the Northeim Territory
(b) The Office of The Secretary to the Department of Northern Developitient
(3) to approve of the abotition, in pursuance of the Public Service Act 1922-1975, of all Second, Third and Fourth
Division offices in the Departments specified in {1} above
(4) to approve of the establishment, m pursuance of section 64 of the Constitution, of a Department of State
namely, The Department of Northern Australia
(5) to approve of the creation, in pursuance of the Public Service Act 1922-1975, of the Office of The Secretary
to the Department of Northern Austratia to be the Permanent Head of The Department of Northern Australia
(6) to approve the creation, pursuant to section 29 of the Public Service Act 1922-1975, of offices in the Department
of Northern Australia, the same in number, designatioa, classification, salary, Division and location as those
existing in the Second, Third and Fourth Divisions of the Department of the Northern Territory and in the
Department of Northern Development immediately prior to 6 June 1975.
(7) to approve of the following change in the name of a Department of State— ¢

instrument (including regulations) made or issued under any such Ordinance, to the Minister of State for the Northern
Territory or to the Department of the Northern Territory shall be read as a reference to the Minister of State for
Northern Australia or to the Department of Northern Australia, as the case may be.

industry Development Corporation Act 1970-1973 and the matters dealt with by the Department of

under that Act; and

(b) hereby approve the continuation in force of the administrative arrangements set out in the Administrative
Arrangements Order made on 1 October 1974 except in relation to the enactments and matters referred to

His Excellency the Governor-General has been pleased to approve:
(2) the abolition, in pursuance of section 64 of the Constitution, of the following Departments of State, namely—

(b) The Department of Secondary Industry
(c} The Department of Supply

(b) The office of The Secretary to the Department of Secondary Industry
{c) The office of The Secretary to the Department of Supply

offices in the Departments specified in (1) above
(4) the establishment, in pursvance of section 64 of the Constitution, of a Department of State namely, The
Department of Manufacturing Industry.

the advice of the Federal Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrangements

ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS.
ORDERED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL.
SIR WILLIAM JOSEPH SLIM, the Governor-General in and over the Commonwealth of Australia, acting with the advice of the Federal
Executive Council, hereby approve the following administrative arrangements in substitution for the arrangements in operation immediately
before the date of this Order:—
The matters dealt with by each Department of State of the Commonwealth include the matters specified in the second column of the
Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department in the first column of that Schedule (except to the extent to which any such matter
is comprised in the administration of an enactment specified in the third column of that Schedule opposite to the name of another Department)
and other matters arising under the enactments administered by the Minister of State administering that Department.
The enactments administered by the Minister of State administering a Department are the enactments specified in the third column of
the Schedule to this Order opposite to the name of that Department and any enactment (whether passed before or after the date of this Order),
not being an enactment specified at any place in that third column, that relates to a matter specified in the second column of that Schedule
opposite to the name of that Department.
Given under my Hand and the Great Seal of the Commonwealth this twenty-third day of April, One thousand nine hundred and
fifty-eight. :
SLIM
Governor-General,
